# Photo credits

Tour photos used in the partner portal's sample data. They are the same files as `rider-app/assets/photos/`; see `rider-app/assets/photos/CREDITS.md` for what each one shows.

All photos were supplied by the Cabo team in October 2026. Confirm the right to use each one (and add the photographer's credit) before a public release. `lagos-at-night.jpg` carries an "f27" watermark, so it is probably a third-party photo.
